| # | Dialog Topic | Form ID | Response Text | Script Notes | 
| 3 | 00602AFB | 00602B66 | Always happy to chat with a customer. What do you need? | *Friendly* | 
| 4 | 00602B67 | Couldn't resist, could you? Well, it's no surprise, there's few that can match my prices. | *Friendly, proud* | 
| 5 | 00602B68 | Minerva, at your service. Looking for some weaponry schematics? Maybe a pattern for a swanky new set of armor? | *Friendly, proud* | 
| 6 | 00602B69 | Aha, you could have gone to any old merchant, but you, my friend, have that special refined taste. Very nice. | *Playful* | 
| 7 | 00602B6A | Won't be around forever, so make sure you snag any deals that pique your interests. | *Friendly* | 
| 13 | 00602AFC | 00602B51 | I sell plans, schematics, and recipes supreme. From weapons to armors, and all things between. | *Playful rhythm, like a carnival barker* | 
| 14 | Drawn from my memory: a human copying machine. All found at prices that you've never seen! | *emphasis on "my", continue the rhythm* | 
| 15 | 00602B52 | Friends and patrons, today is the day. Minerva's store has returned, so do not delay | *Playful rhythm, like a carnival barker* | 
| 16 | With plans for weapons to keep baddies at bay. Shop while you can for this caravan won't stay! | *continue the rhythm* | 
| 17 | 00602B54 | Welcome! Don't be shy. I won't be around for long, so browse while you can. | *Carnival barker, snake oil salesman* | 
| 18 | 00602B55 | Hello, Appalachia! The name's Minerva, my game's hand-crafted replications of the rarest plans and recipes! | *carnival barker* | 
| 19 | Every component and mechanism, recreated precisely to a fraction of a hundredth of a millimeter! | | 
| 20 | 00602B56 | Why pay full price when you can buy my recreations at a discount? | *carnival barker* | 
| 21 | 00602B57 | Shop while you can, I won't be here long! If you don't see something you're interested in, I'll have a different assortment next time I'm in town. | *carnival barker* | 
| 22 | 00602B58 | Behold! Picture perfect copies of plans and recipes! Hand-drawn from my photographic memory, you'd never know these weren't the real thing! | *carnival barker, like she's describing the eight wonder of the world* | 
| 23 | 00602B59 | My photographic memory allows me to share plans from far and wide at prices that can't be beat! | *carnival barker* | 
| 24 | Every schematic and recipe recreated to perfection. Satisfaction guaranteed! | *Salesman* | 
| 25 | 00602B5A | See a plan that strikes your fancy? Better pick it up today. My stock is constantly changing, so you might not live to see the same plan twice! | *carnival barker* | 
| 26 | 00602B5B | To all my Raiders of the Crater, lay down your arms and pick up these hot deals! | *Acting like it's a plea for peace, turns into a sales pitch* | 
| 27 | 00602B5C | Hello, Crater! These prices are so good, it's practically robbery! So, please, don't actually rob me... | *Carnival barker, turning into under the breath* | 
| 28 | 00602B5D | People of Foundation, I come bearing tidings of low prices! No need to shop around, "settle" on these bargains today! | *Carnival barker. Foundation call themselves "settlers" so emphasize for the pun* | 
| 29 | 00602B5E | My travels take me far and wide. Today Foundation, but maybe next time I'll be in the Crater. In other words... Buy something while you can! | *Carnival barker. Crater is a very dangerous place.* | 
| 30 | 00602B5F | Nothing says "Ad Victoriam" like great prices and rare finds! Fall in for steep savings, Brothers! | *Carnival barker* | 
| 31 | 00602B60 | You don't need to be a Scribe to see these schematics are the real deal! Shop for firepower to take back Appalachia! | *Carnival barker* | 
| 32 | 00602B61 | Come browse my wares, from exotic to rare, my inventory's legendary, but my prices are fair! | *Playful rhythm, like a carnival barker* | 
| 35 | See you later. | 00602D5E | Mmhmm. But don't forget, I won't be around here forever. Make sure you grab the goods you want before they're gone! | *Friendly reminder* | 
| 36 | 00602D37 | 00602D63 | Drum roll, please... | *About to reveal something* | 
| 37 | What's with the big Ghoul in the hat? | 00602D5A | Tommy? Well it wouldn't be a caravan without someone riding shotgun. He may seem intimidating, but he's a big goofy teddy bear. | | 
| 38 | Loves to chat, so say hi. | | 
| 39 | Try and steal something, though, and he will rip your sternum out. I've seen him do it. Very graphic. | *Maybe true, maybe not, but playful delivery* | 
| 40 | How long will you be here? | 00602D5B | Not long. So if you've got your eye on something act fast. | | 
| 41 | My stock is constantly rotating with new and exciting observations from my travels. | | 
| 42 | But that also means you're unlikely to see the same thing on back to back visits, so grab what you can while I'm here. | | 
| 43 | What sort of things do you sell here? | 00602D3C | You'd think with all the carnival barking I do, I wouldn't get this question much. But alas, here I go answering it again. | *Not too snarky, more laughing at herself* | 
| 44 | My caravan sells recreations of all sorts of rare plans and recipes, at discounted prices no less. | *Friendly* | 
| 45 | I've got what you'd call... a photographic memory. If I've seen it, I can picture it, and draw it exactly so. | *Proud of herself* | 
| 46 | "The human copying machine," they say, but I suspect that name will lose its veneer once anyone that remembers copying machines has died off. | *A little side joke* | 
| 47 | If you're interested in plans at unbeatable prices, I'm the best that the Blue Ridge Caravan Company has. | *Sales pitch* | 
| 63 | I wanted to ask about something else. | 00602D5C | What else did you want to know? | | 
| 64 | Okay then, let me take a look at your stock. | 00602D62 | Now, that's a smart move. | *money in her eyes* | 
| 65 | I thought you make all this from memory. Why can't you just offer everything all the time? | 00602D60 | My mind may be unending, but I can only draw so much before my wrist snaps in two. | *chuckling at the idea* | 
| 66 | Not many treatments for carpal tunnel syndrome in the Wasteland, you know. | | 
| 67 | Thanks, that's all I wanted to know. | 00602D66 | Sure thing. | | 
| 68 | You're with the Blue Ridge Caravan Company? | 00602D5F | Sure am. Been with 'em since I was pint sized brainy brat. | | 
| 69 | I'm originally from DC. Survived the bombs thanks to my local library seconding as a bomb shelter. | | 
| 70 | Wound up wandering from group to group, until my talents caught the eye of some Blue Ridge folk passing through. | | 
| 71 | Ended up being an apprentice for a book salesman, rewriting books by hand. He was a dear friend and great mentor. | | 
| 72 | After he passed, I took over his caravan. Switched from books to something a little more catered for the modern survivor's needs, though. | | 
| 73 | But Blue Ridge are my business partners and my family... And I couldn't ask for a better one. | | 
| 74 | A photographic memory? Isn't this a waste of your talent? | 00602D64 | And what else could I be spending my talent on, pray tell? Turning a profit is all I know, and I ever want to know. | *Not being mean, but also humored by the question... Like really?* |
